claims.text: ↓MAP ≈20–25% over the first hr w a short-acting titratable IV med (clevidipine, NTG, fenoldopam, nicardipine, labetalol)
claims.quote: Reduce mean arterial pressure by about 20 to 25% over the first hour using a short-acting, titratable IV medication such as clevidipine, nitroglycerin, fenoldopam, nicardipine, or labetalol.
